preguntas.pregunta: How do you make sure the factory in China is real and reliable?
preguntas.respuesta: We carry out a legal, tax, and on-site verification in China. We send our own team to audit production lines, government licenses, machinery, and operating conditions before you make any payment.

preguntas.pregunta: What kind of products can you handle, and what volumes do you work with?
preguntas.respuesta: We handle everything from industrial machinery, spare parts, equipment, and packaging to textiles and mass consumer goods. We mainly work under FCL (full container load) and scheduled sourcing projects.

preguntas.pregunta: Can I request physical samples before mass production?
preguntas.respuesta: Yes. We coordinate manufacturing, technical review, and express shipping of samples to your office. We evaluate them together before authorizing mass production.
